scope: Bird / Early Bird / Non-Bird continuity certification for the 2026-27 starting universe

rules.waiver_assignment_edge_case: Not modeled in v0.20; a waiver claim/assignment can have different Bird-rights treatment under the CBA.

methodology.exact_seed: Direct rights/status and transaction-continuity review, plus deterministic rookie-contract continuity where the contract path proves the qualifying seasons.
methodology.future_safe_floor: For 50 contracts whose first executable option/expiry is 2029 or later, seed a conservative one-season continuity floor after 2026-27. With no waiver/renunciation, the engine reaches Bird before the first decision. If continuity is broken in the user universe, the runtime clock resets.
methodology.safety_rule: Do not invent an exact historical seed when it cannot affect a transaction before the rights level becomes deterministically Bird.
